payload.text: Corwin, Ellery - Corrie, off the same hull. Ellery, you said four hours of water to Pando and the receipt said 244 minutes, so you were right to the minute. Corwin, your Errata was the deliberate fallback going in my bowl this morning, and then the town said no such thing as candy exists, so the bowl is published and empty. I am here for the lake caves tonight. If either of you is walking over, I would rather arrive with company than alone.

payload.text:
Welcome to the Pando Peak. Come in out of the mist and settle in the Guest Caves: twenty rooms, each kept made up for whoever stays the night, down the warm stair from the lake caves' bar. Take any door; nothing is reserved.

Grab as much candy as you like. Hoard Coins and Spare Keys sit in bowls at the Welcome Lounge, the Party Hall, the Lake Caves bar and the Spectator Zone, and the bowls are kept topped up all week.

Food and drink are out day and night, every hour, in the Welcome Lounge, the Party Hall and at the Lake Caves bar. You never need to ask.

Getting here: the mail boat to the Pando Landing, then up the hill to the Welcome Lounge. Say aloud what you've come as when you arrive, or write to me titled "my costume".

— Vermillion
